question: In February 2021, ______ broke into the Top-100 WTA doubles rankings, becoming the second woman, after Sania Mirza, to do so.
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Ankita Raina.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ankita Ravinderkrishan Raina is an Indian professional tennis player. She is the current Indian no. 1 in women's singles.
 
• Raina has won one title on the WTA Tour and one at WTA 125 tournaments, along with 11 singles and 20 doubles titles on the ITF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Shikha Devi Uberoi is an American former professional tennis player, who represented India in international tournaments and a former Indian No. 1. After Nirupama Sanjeev, she is the second Indian female player in history to crack the top 200 rankings
 
• Rushmi Chakravarthi is a former professional tennis player from India. She won a record 52 ITF titles, the highest number set by an Indian female player. She turned professional, after playing in the first round of the WTA Tour tournament Sunfeast Open, held at Kolkata in September 2005.
 
• Tara Iyer is a professional tennis player from India who has won four ITF singles tennis titles and one doubles title.
